verdict.rationale: Make documents a public REST API with resource-oriented URLs, token and OAuth 2.0 authentication flows, a TypeScript SDK, and reference endpoints for connections, data stores, AI agents, audit logs and more. That lets a user or agent drive the product programmatically. Missing for 10: a machine-readable OpenAPI/Swagger spec (all probed paths returned 404), and independent or hands-on corroboration that the API works end to end.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: The Make API follows the REST API design. Make API is organized into resource-oriented URLs
All requests to the Make API require authentication with the user authentication token with the relevant scopes enabled.
The Make Typescript SDK provides full support for type definitions and a majority of Make API endpoints, built-in error handling, and response typing.
The following endpoints allow you to get, create, update, delete, and run AI Agents.
Retrieves a collection of all connections for a team with a given ID.
